inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): While reviewing personnel records 4 out 4 files were missing the pre-employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Age Range of Children In Care: This standard was reviewed during an investigation and was found to be deficient. There is sufficient evidence that supports that the operation has been caring for school age children without notifying CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Age Range of Children In Care (26 TAC §746.301(5))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver was observed utilizing her personal cellphone while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present: During the inspection there was a caregiver supervising two classroom during naptime. However, the caregiver was not physically present in the same area as both classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: During the walk through it was found that the operation moved the infant classroom from the back of the building to the pre-k classroom without notifying CCR and amending the permit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: There was an infant observed asleep in their crib with a bib on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: During the inspection there was an infant observed to be left unsupervised while asleep in their crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation's fire inspection expired on 3/14/2024 and a recent fire inspection has not been conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: While reviewing personnel files 5 caregivers did not have a current certificate for CPR/ First Aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: While reviewing children files I observed 4 out of 6 files were missing required information such as; information for emergency contacts, updated immunizations, release information, acknowledgment of operational policies, water activity permissions, and transportation permissions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: While reviewing personnel files one caregiver was missing the following; notarized affidavit, pre-employment affidavit, and orientation statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: The children records were reviewed. Two records were missing updated shot records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit was incomplete and was missing gauze pads and the guide to first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: The children records were reviewed and one record did not have the emergency contact address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: The food allergy alert plan for 2 children with an allergy was not available at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting): The use zone for the rocking piece of equipment did not have a 6 foot use zone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting) (26 TAC §746.4813(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was observed sleeping in a restrictive device at nap.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Upon arrival at the operation there was one caregivere caring for 26 children ages 6m-5years at nap time. This was corrected within 30 minutes when the other caregivers arrived from lunch and for their afternoon shifts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During inspection the two infant rooms were out of ratio. One infant room had 1 caregiver with 5 infants 3m-11m. The second infant room had 1 caregiver for 6 children SAG 17m. Both room ratios were corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: An infant was observed to be unbuckled in the highchair with the tray detached. The child was attempting to climb out of the highchair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: During inspection it was observed that a caregiver left 6 children alone in a room ages 11m-2 years, SAG of 17m, in high chairs when the caregiver left the room to go to their car. This was corrected when the caregiver returned to the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Label for Each Infant: During inspection it was observed that the infant play yards did not have a name for each child on the cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(I))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Summary of Activities: During inspection the infant daily reports were reviewed and did not have a spot for the summary of daily activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Summary of Activities (26 TAC §746.2431(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Immunization records were reviewed for the HASA. Two records were not current and up to date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During inspection one classroom was observed to be over ratio while waiting for two caregivers to arrive for work. This was corrected during inspection when the caregivers arrived.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: During follow up inspection, 1 infant was observed asleep unbuckled in a high chair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity: During a follow up inspection the operation was operating with 44 children present and capacity is 38 children for the operation total.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity (26 TAC §746.201(11))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During inspection, one classroom was over ratio. The 2 - 3 yrs old class had 16 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: During follow up inspection, 1 infant was observed asleep unbuckled in a high chair, 3 infants were observed in high chairs unbuckled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: A follow up was conducted on this day. The immunization record has not been provided by the parent and is not current. The standard was re-cited.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: A follow up was conducted on this day. One of the children present did not have an updated feeding instruction. The standard was re-cited.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity: During a follow up inspection the operation was operating with 41 children present and capacity is 38 children for the operation total.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity (26 TAC §746.201(11))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: A follow up was conducted on this day. The SIDS and Shaken Baby training was not found in the employee file as complete. This standard was re-cited.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Training records were reviewed for the HASA  and one record was missing training for SIDS and Shaken Baby.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Four children files were reviewed for the HASA and one file did not have a current immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Benefits: The operational policies were reviewed and were missing the activity portion, specifically the benefits of physical activity, duration of play and  where the children will go in the event of extreme weather.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Benefits (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: An employee was observed cleaning an infants hands after a diaper change with a baby wipe. This was corrected when the caregiver washed the infants hands with water and soap.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The activity plans were reviewed and there is only one outdoor time listed for the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The infant feeding instructions were reviewed and have not been updated in the last 30 days. The last date of review was on 4/1/22
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Traning was reviewed for the HASA and one employee did not have child maltreatment training as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The grounds checklist were observed  for the HASA and had not been completed since February of 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children: During inspection it was observed that there were only large play items availble for the children to play with in the room and accessible.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children (26 TAC §746.2505(3))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: During inspection Lysol wipes were obsesrved to be on a low shelf in the bathroom that the children use and have access to. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Substitutes and Volunteers - Complete Orientation Before Beginning Relevant Duties: This standard was reviewed in relation to the DFPS investigation and found to be deficient. One substitute present at the operation did not have a complete orientation before being counted in child/caregiver ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Substitutes and Volunteers - Complete Orientation Before Beginning Relevant Duties (26 TAC §746.1401(g))
